The Treatment

What Is
RF Microneedling?

RF Microneedling combines two proven technologies: microneedling, which creates controlled micro-injuries in the skin to trigger healing, and radiofrequency energy, which delivers heat to the deeper dermal layers to stimulate collagen and elastin remodelling.

Together, they achieve what neither treatment can alone — simultaneously improving skin surface quality and stimulating deep structural change. The result is firmer, smoother, more even skin that continues to improve over the following months.

Each session takes 45–60 minutes. Most clients need a course of 3 sessions for optimal results.

Why Choose It

The Benefits

01
Dual-Action Technology

Microneedling triggers surface healing while RF energy stimulates deep collagen and elastin — achieving more than either treatment alone.

02
Improves Multiple Concerns

Fine lines, mild skin laxity, acne scars, enlarged pores, uneven texture — RF Microneedling addresses a wide range of skin concerns in one treatment.

03
Results Continue Building

Collagen production is a slow process. You'll notice improvement in the weeks following treatment, with peak results at 3–6 months.

04
Minimal Downtime

Some redness and mild swelling for 24–48 hours is normal. Most clients return to normal activities within a couple of days.

05
Suitable for Most Skin Types

Because the RF energy is delivered below the surface, the treatment is generally safe for all skin tones.

06
Medically Delivered

Performed by Nafisa Mughal using state-of-the-art equipment in our clinical Winslow setting.

Ideal Candidates

Who Is It
Right For?

RF Microneedling suits those wanting to improve skin quality and firmness without surgery or significant downtime.

Those with mild to moderate skin laxity, fine lines or crepey skin texture

Clients with acne scarring they want to visibly improve

Anyone with enlarged pores or uneven skin texture

Those looking for a course-based treatment with progressive, lasting results

Clients who want to maintain or extend the results of other treatments

The Process

How It Works

A precise, personalised procedure delivered at our Winslow clinic.

1

Consultation

Nafisa assesses your skin concerns, texture and laxity. She'll confirm whether RF Microneedling alone or combined with other treatments is the right approach.

2

Preparation

Topical anaesthetic cream is applied 30–45 minutes before treatment for comfort. The skin is cleansed and prepared.

3

Treatment

The RF Microneedling device delivers precise micro-injuries and radiofrequency energy simultaneously. Treatment takes approximately 45–60 minutes.

4

Immediate Aftercare

Your skin will be red and slightly swollen — similar to mild sunburn. A soothing serum is applied and aftercare instructions provided.

5

Recovery & Results

Redness typically resolves within 24–48 hours. Collagen remodelling continues for weeks and months following treatment.
